subject: c-act
title: C.ACT.------DYM.F.
description: Diagram in CMBA-29, the first on book p273. (C)C-ACT (composite activism) is crossed with DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). The diagram is densely populated with prefixed nodes — (R)INDIV-TD (the reality of individual tendencies), (R)LANG (the reality of language), (P)RE-DIF (the point of idea completion of redefinitions). C-ACT outputs to DYM-F (the crossing) and MT-INFO (multi-information). MT-INFO branches to C-CONT (composite continuance) and (R)INDIV-TD. C-CONT leads to TR (transformation) → SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). (R)INDIV-TD branches to INFO-F (information focus) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism); ALT-F branches to GRAD (gradualism) and (R)LANG, and (R)LANG to (P)RE-DIF.
